scope: Prepare existing inputs and validate portfolio evaluator; no fitted MacroState contest yet
primary_comparison: top ceil(eligible_count * 0.20), equal weight, versus equal weight eligible markets
broad_benchmark: also report equal weight all markets with valid trailing price history, even when valuation is unavailable
execution_basis: monthly USD gross total-return index proxy; preceding month-end information to subsequent monthly returns; not executable next-session fills
missing_outcome_policy: raise, never delete selected holdings or reweight around missing outcomes
eligibility: positive observed TRI at decision, contiguous 12-month return history; scored comparison also requires positive PB and trailing momentum
normalization: own-history z using previous 60 completed months, minimum 36 nonmissing observations; clip [-3,3]; never future rows
input_timing: daily vendor observations <= completed prior month-end, max age 10 calendar days; monthly workbook at prior month-end with no further forward fill
vendor_history_status: conditional historical reconstruction; vendor revisions and Bloomberg carry-forward are not independently certified
controls: fixed equal-weight cross-sectional cheap-PB rank plus trailing 12-to-1-month momentum rank; evaluator plumbing demonstration only
source_selection: fixed from prior economic and provenance audit, no return-based feature selection
